source.install_hint: Install MatOS and expose its `matos` CLI on PATH, or set STUDYUI_MATOS_CLI=/path/to/matos. StudyUI never vendors or executes the downloaded MatOS source tree.
source.attribution: The MatOS tool names, descriptions, permissions and JSON input schemas in this catalog are adapted from the MatOS benchmark-minimal distribution. StudyUI does not bundle or execute MatOS source code; execution is delegated to a user-installed `matos` CLI and its `matos assets run-tool` JSON interface.

tools.name: Agent Orchestration
tools.description: Sub-agent, task, and coordination tools used for multi-step workflows.
tools.notes: MatOS/DeepSeek Harness builtin sub-agent and task tools.

tools.name: Atomistic Toolchain Catalog
tools.description: Discover and probe mounted atomistic simulation tools such as xTB, CREST, GROMACS, OpenMM, PLUMED, ABACUS, CP2K, Quantum ESPRESSO, Wannier90, GW/BSE stacks, and QMCPACK.
Optional subset of tools to inspect. Defaults to all supported entries.

toolchainRoot.description: Optional container-visible toolchain root override. Defaults to MATOS_EXTERNAL_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT, MATOS_CONTAINER_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT, MATOS_COMPUTE_TOOLCHAIN_CONTAINER_ROOT, /opt/matos-tools, then the configured host toolchain root.

probe.description: Whether to run lightweight version/import probes. Defaults to true.

tools.notes: Read-only discovery and probe of mounted atomistic solvers.
tools.usage_hint: Use `mcp__matos_asset__atomistic_toolchain_catalog` before selecting xTB, CREST, GROMACS, OpenMM, PLUMED, ABACUS, CP2K, Quantum ESPRESSO, Wannier90, GW/BSE, or QMCPACK runtime paths.

tools.name: Battery Electrochemistry Catalog
tools.description: Discover and probe the mounted battery/electrochemistry macro-scale modelling toolchain: PyBaMM, PyBOP, BPX, liionpack, and OpenPNM.

toolchainRoot.description: Optional toolchain root override. Defaults to MATOS_EXTERNAL_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT/MATOS_CONTAINER_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT, then /opt/matos-tools or the local host toolchain root.

envName.description: Shared Conda environment name to inspect.

probePackages.description: Import PyBaMM, PyBOP, BPX, liionpack, and OpenPNM with the environment Python.

includeExamples.description: Include recommended MatOS tool/workflow entrypoints and example tasks.

tools.notes: Read-only discovery of mounted battery/electrochemistry packages.
tools.usage_hint: Discover the real MatOS battery/electrochemistry macro-scale modelling stack.

tools.name: Conda Environment Catalog
tools.description: List system and user-persistent Conda environments available to the current MatOS agent runtime.

includeSystem.description: Include shared read-only system environments under MATOS_SYSTEM_CONDA_ENVS_PATH or /opt/matos-tools/conda/envs.

includeUser.description: Include current-user persistent environments under MATOS_USER_CONDA_ENVS_PATH or /workspace/caches/conda/envs.

probePackages.description: Run each environment's Python to probe selected imports and Torch CUDA metadata. Defaults to false so the catalog returns quickly; enable explicitly for deep preflight.

includeGpu.description: When package probing is enabled, include Torch CUDA availability/device metadata. Set true only when GPU package metadata is needed.

imports.description: Optional import names to probe. Defaults to common scientific and MLIP packages.

limit.description: Maximum number of environments to return.

includeSourceRouting.description: Include the package-source route injected by the MatOS runtime for user environment creation.

format.description: Return a bounded routing summary by default. Use full only for operator diagnostics that need every configured recommendation and runtime hint.

tools.usage_hint: Use `mcp__matos_asset__conda_environment_catalog` before selecting Python for materials, MLIP, or local compute scripts.

tools.name: Conda Environment Manager
tools.description: Create current-user persistent Conda environments and install Python packages into those user-scoped environments only.

action.description: create_env creates a user-scoped Conda env. pip_install installs packages into an existing user env. ensure_packages creates the env if missing, installs requested packages, and probes imports. probe checks imports without changing the env.

envName.description: User environment name. The resolved prefix is always <userEnvRoot>/<envName>; absolute paths and ../ are rejected.

pythonVersion.description: Python version for create_env or ensure_packages when the env does not exist.

packages.description: PyPI package specifiers to install, such as doped or doped==3.1.0. URLs, local paths, whitespace, and leading dash options are rejected.

imports.description: Import names to probe after create/install, such as doped.

dryRun.description: Return the planned command and validated prefix without executing conda or pip.

tools.notes: Creates current-user Conda environments; never writes shared/system environments.

tools.name: Deep Research Scholarly Search
tools.description: Provider-agnostic scholarly literature search (OpenAlex) for the deep-research agent. Works on any model provider, unlike the Anthropic-only WebSearch tool.

query.description: Search query (topic, keywords, or a specific question). Required.

limit.description: Maximum number of sources to return (default 6).

from_year.description: Optional. Only include works published on/after this year.

tools.notes: OpenAlex scholarly search; provider-agnostic and keyless.
tools.usage_hint: Search scholarly literature (OpenAlex) for source-backed deep research.

tools.name: Document Parse (local files)
tools.description: Extract plain text from a local document (PDF, DOCX, HTML, TXT/MD/CSV/JSON, and other office formats via LibreOffice). For remote URLs/PDFs use web_read instead.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to a local document file. Required.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of extracted text to return (default 60000).

start_char.description: Character offset to start reading from. Use next_start_char from a truncated response to continue without losing text.

tools.notes: PDF/DOCX/HTML text extraction with Python fallbacks.
tools.usage_hint: Extract text from a LOCAL document file (PDF, DOCX, HTML, TXT/MD/CSV/JSON, etc.).

tools.name: Files Core
tools.description: Read, search, and edit local workspace files.
tools.notes: MatOS/DeepSeek Harness builtin workspace file tools.

tools.name: Gemini Vision Analyze
tools.description: Analyze a local image with Gemini multimodal models through an OpenAI-compatible or native Gemini endpoint. Use when the current agent model cannot inspect images directly.

imagePath.description: Local path to the image. Relative paths are resolved from the current workspace roots when possible.

context.description: Short task context for the vision model: what the image is, why it matters, and what the agent/user wants to know.

question.description: Specific visual question to answer. Defaults to a concise description and issue-focused inspection.

model.description: Optional Gemini model override. Defaults to GEMINI_MODEL or gemini-3.1-pro-preview.

detail.description: Level of visual detail requested. Defaults to full.

thinkingBudget.description: Google native thinking budget. Defaults to 0 so visual summaries do not spend the output budget on hidden thinking.

tools.notes: Calls a Gemini-compatible vision endpoint; network access required.
tools.usage_hint: Analyze a local image with Gemini vision.

tools.name: Literature Access
tools.description: Credential-safe literature access planner and local library scanner for OA, Zotero/PDF libraries, institution proxy/VPN, and browser-login handoff workflows.

action.description: status reports configured access channels; plan returns a safe acquisition plan; scan indexes local PDF/BibTeX files; resolve checks legal open-access locations for DOI inputs.

query.description: Research topic, title, author, or free-text query used to filter local files and build next actions.

dois.description: DOIs to resolve through legal open-access metadata providers.

libraryRoots.description: Optional container-visible local library roots to scan. Defaults to MATOS_LITERATURE_LIBRARY_ROOTS and common workspace literature folders.

maxResults.description: Maximum local file or DOI records to return. Default 50.

maxDepth.description: Maximum directory depth for local library scan. Default 5.

tools.notes: Credential-safe local-library scan and legal open-access DOI resolution.
tools.usage_hint: Use this tool before or during literature work when a paper may require access.

tools.name: Local Toolchain Preflight
tools.description: Check whether the MatOS local/container scientific toolchain is mounted and usable before QE, Elk, Wannier90, GW/BSE, LAMMPS, VASP wrapper, ORCA, Thermo-Calc, or Conda execution.

checks.description: Optional subset of local toolchain checks. Defaults to the standard core checks: vasp, qe, lammps, conda, and python. Pass elk, openfoam, gpu, wannier90, gw, orca, or thermocalc explicitly when needed.

tools.description: Compatibility alias for checks. Prefer checks in new calls.

toolchainRoot.description: Optional container-visible toolchain root override. Defaults to MATOS_EXTERNAL_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT, MATOS_CONTAINER_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT, MATOS_COMPUTE_TOOLCHAIN_CONTAINER_ROOT, then /opt/matos-tools.

timeoutSeconds.description: Per-command timeout for non-expensive help/version checks. Defaults to 20 seconds because QE, pw2wannier90.x, and ABINIT startup probes can take several seconds on shared storage.

detail.description: Return compact tool status only with summary, or include detailed diagnostics and runtime library paths with full. Defaults to full for backward compatibility.

gpuIdleUtilizationMaxPercent.description: GPU utilization percentage at or below this threshold is considered idle for local routing.

gpuIdleMemoryUsedMiBMax.description: GPU memory used at or below this threshold is considered idle for local routing.

tools.notes: Read-only preflight; never runs production calculations.
tools.usage_hint: Check the current MatOS local/container scientific toolchain before direct local execution of Quantum ESPRESSO, LAMMPS, OpenFOAM, VASP wrapper commands, Elk workflows, Wannier90 commands, GW/BSE commands, ORCA, Thermo-Calc, or the toolchain Conda environment. It can also inspect local/container GPU visibility and utilization with `checks:["gpu"]`.

tools.name: Materials Runtime Inventory
tools.description: Summarize the currently mounted local materials runtime assets: toolchains, Conda environments, MLIP models, and QE pseudopotentials.

includeConda.description: Include system and current-user Conda environment inventory.

includeMlip.description: Include mounted MLIP model assets and runtime package status.

includeQePseudo.description: Include QE SSSP pseudopotential mount summary.

detail.description: Return compact inventory by default, or fuller nested catalog outputs for diagnosis.

timeoutSeconds.description: Per-section timeout for delegated read-only catalog calls.

tools.notes: Aggregates toolchain, Conda, MLIP and pseudopotential catalogs.
tools.usage_hint: Use `mcp__matos_asset__materials_runtime_inventory` first when a compute task depends on local mounted assets and you need to know what is available before choosing QE, LAMMPS, VASP, MLIP/MACE, Conda, or pseudopotentials.

tools.name: MLIP Model Catalog
tools.description: List locally mounted machine-learning interatomic-potential model assets and runtime package availability.

family.description: Optional model family filter, for example mace, chgnet, matgl, sevennet, orb, mattersim, fairchem, nequip, or torchsim.

availableOnly.description: When true, only return model assets with an existing local model file.

includePackages.description: Include import/package availability for known MLIP runtimes.

verifyChecksum.description: Compute SHA-256 for local files and compare with manifest checksums. This may read large model files.

limit.description: Maximum number of model assets to return.

tools.notes: Read-only inventory of mounted machine-learning interatomic potentials.
tools.usage_hint: Use `mcp__matos_asset__mlip_model_catalog` before writing MACE, CHGNet, MatGL, SevenNet, ORB, MatterSim, FairChem, NequIP, Allegro, or TorchSim scripts.

tools.name: Materials Project Query
tools.description: Query the Materials Project database for crystal structures and computed properties by formula or materials-id.

formula.description: Chemical formula to search, e.g. 'Si' or 'SiO2'.

fields.description: Optional list of property fields to return.

limit.description: Max number of entries to return when searching by formula.

tools.notes: Read-only Materials Project REST query; network access required.
tools.usage_hint: Look up crystal structures and computed properties from the Materials Project (https://materialsproject.org) database.

tools.name: SCIP Toolchain Catalog
tools.description: Discover and validate the mounted SCIP Optimization Suite toolchain for mixed-integer, nonlinear, and decomposition optimization tasks.

toolchainRoot.description: Optional toolchain root override. Defaults to MATOS_EXTERNAL_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT, MATOS_CONTAINER_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT, MATOS_COMPUTE_TOOLCHAIN_CONTAINER_ROOT, /opt/matos-tools, then the configured host toolchain root.

probe.description: Whether to run lightweight version/import probes. Defaults to true.

smoke.description: Whether to solve tiny CLI and PySCIPOpt MILP smoke problems. Defaults to false.

timeoutSeconds.description: Per-probe timeout in seconds. Defaults to 10.

tools.notes: Read-only SCIP/SoPlex/GCG discovery with optional smoke test.
tools.usage_hint: Use `mcp__matos_asset__scip_toolchain_catalog` before running SCIP, SoPlex, GCG, or PySCIPOpt. The tool returns container-visible paths under `/opt/matos-tools` and can run a small real optimization smoke test.

tools.name: Shell Core
tools.description: Execute shell commands inside the current runtime.

tools.name: Web/PDF Read
tools.description: Read a public URL and return clean Markdown. Uses Jina Reader for rendered pages and PDFs, with bounded proxy/direct routes and an SSRF-guarded public HTML fallback. Provider-agnostic and keyless by default.

url.description: Public http(s) URL to read (web page or PDF). Jina handles rendered pages/PDFs; public HTML has a bounded direct fallback.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of Markdown to return (default 40000).

tools.notes: Public URL/PDF to Markdown via Jina Reader with bounded fallbacks.
tools.usage_hint: Read a public URL (web page or PDF) as clean Markdown. The tool uses Jina Reader first and automatically falls back to bounded public-HTML reads when Jina or its configured proxy route is unavailable.

tools.name: Web Research
tools.description: Builtin web search and fetch tools.
tools.notes: MatOS/DeepSeek Harness builtin web search/fetch tools.
